findings.summary: Net physical LoC reduction is not proved and appears unsatisfied for the full requested scope: the WP-12 wrapper dropped from 241 to 13 lines, but the issue branch remains net positive from main once the Runtime API and proof surface are included.
The initially assigned Locke review scope omitted .csdlc/issues/5665/index.json even though the review was asked to cover lifecycle state.
findings.route: Superseded by this direct csdlc-review record, whose scope includes .csdlc/issues/5665/index.json.

residual_risk: The strict Clippy retained log is terse and records Cargo success rather than echoing the full command; the command was rerun and the typed SOR records the argv.
#5663 and #5664 protected-path records were not visible in this worktree; visible #5657 protected paths were disjoint from the changed paths.
